quote: You spend years building walls around your fragile heart. You guard every entrance against the looming threat of pain. Yet the ones who hurt you never had to break in. They simply walked through doors you left open from love. And now you sit quietly in the wreckage of your hope. Wondering why kindness always costs you more than you can spare.
